previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's central nervous system lymphoma, was admitted for his 14th cycle of maintenance chemotherapy with intravenous rituximab and high-dose methotrexate. He reported stable symptoms, including persistent floaters, and denied new neurological or systemic complaints. He received rituximab followed by high-dose methotrexate with aggressive hydration and urinary alkalinization. Leucovorin rescue was initiated once his methotrexate level dropped to 0.31 µM and was continued until levels fell below 0.06 µM. His kidney function remained stable throughout, and liver enzymes showed mild, non-progressive elevation. An MRI of the brain with contrast revealed no new enhancing lesions or significant changes, indicating no lymphoma progression. He tolerated the regimen well without complications and was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to continue his home medications and monitor for any concerning symptoms, with follow-up scheduled in four months.

radiology_notes.text:
INDICATION:  ___ man with history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's
lymphoma with CNS involvement. Evaluate for evidence of CNS lymphoma.

COMPARISON:  Multiple prior MR head studies, recent MR head with and without
contrast, ___.

TECHNIQUE:  Pre-contrast axial and sagittal T1-weighted images were obtained. 
Axial T2, axial, FLAIR, gradient and diffusion-weighted images were also
obtained.  Axial T1-weighted images were repeated after administration of
intravenous gadolinium contrast material.  Sagittal and coronal MP-RAGE images
were also provided.

FINDINGS:  A small focus of FLAIR hyperintensity in the left parietal
subcortical white matter (8:17) with associated hypointensity on the
susceptibility images (chronic blood products), is unchanged since the recent
prior study.  This likely represents sequelae of prior biopsy.  No new lesions
are identified.  There is no acute major vascular territorial infarction. 
Upon contrast administration, no abnormal enhancement is detected.  No
diffusion abnormalities are detected in the brain.  The ventricles and sulci
are normal in caliber and configuration.  Major vascular flow voids are
maintained.

IMPRESSION:
1.  There is no significant change since the most recent MRI study of
___.  No evidence of lymphomatous involvement of the brain.
2.  Post-biopsy changes in the left parietal white matter, unchanged.
